last_episode_to_air.overview: Season 7 will thrust our hairy heroes into yet another thrilling mystery surrounding a bear beauty contest, "Mr. Bear America," that will take place in beautiful Palm Springs, California. Our beloved gang of four decide to go relax for a week in the desert and attend "Bear Week" activities. However, they get more then they bargained for when a vicious and dangerous stalker begins to leave each of them threatening notes! At the same time, Reggie is promoting his latest best-selling book and judging the parade of hairy hunks! Wood too is busy self-promoting, by hosting a pool party at a clothing optional resort to push his latest porn opus, along with his gorgeous, furry models. Something that threatens to break him and Nelson apart forever!

seasons.name: Season 3
seasons.overview: Reggie, Wood, Nelson and Todd become involved in yet another thrilling murder mystery surrounding the deaths of sexy “Chunk Studio” cover models! With beefy, bulky hunks dropping like flies, it’s up to our amateur sleuths to find the killer. At the same time, Nelson is cast in an indie horror feature, and the horror on set becomes greater than what’s in the movie’s script. Meanwhile, Todd is forced to go undercover as a Chunk model to help solve the murders. And Reggie enlists Wood to help him shoot a reality TV pilot to help him expand his brand as a true crime expert.

seasons.name: Season 4
seasons.overview: Reggie, Wood, Nelson, and Todd fallinto yet another thrilling murder mystery surrounding the upcoming nuptials of everyone's favorite bear couple, Nelson and Todd! At the same time, Reggie's true crime TV show becomes a hit on the Inquisitive Channel and sparks begin to fly because of his new co-stars Det. Chad Winters and Captain Coley. Meanwhile, Wood decides to start his own swimwear line called "Sporting Wood" with sidekick George Ridgemont which provides them the opportunity to audition, dress and photograph hot bear models for a living! All while Nelson and Todd plan for the wedding of the century which is most sure to go awry!

At the same time, Det.
